WITH error_context AS (
  SELECT
    {{ $json.submission_id ? String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.submission_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) : 'NULL' }} AS submission_id,
    {{ Number($json.delivery_id || 0) }} AS delivery_id,
    {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.current_stage || 'desconhecida').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AS current_stage,
    {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.error_category || 'infraestrutura').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AS error_category,
    {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.error_message || 'falha nao detalhada').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AS error_message,
    {{ $json.execution_id ? String.fromCharCode(39) + String($json.execution_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) : 'NULL' }} AS execution_id
), latest_attempt AS (
  SELECT pa.attempt_id, pa.submission_id
  FROM automacao_miller.processing_attempts pa
  JOIN error_context ctx ON ctx.submission_id = pa.submission_id
  ORDER BY pa.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), logged_error AS (
  INSERT INTO automacao_miller.workflow_errors
    (submission_id, attempt_id, status, current_stage, error_category, error_message, execution_id)
  SELECT ctx.submission_id, attempt.attempt_id, 'erro', ctx.current_stage,
         ctx.error_category, ctx.error_message, ctx.execution_id
  FROM error_context ctx
  LEFT JOIN latest_attempt attempt ON TRUE
  RETURNING submission_id, attempt_id, current_stage, error_category, error_message
), closed_attempt AS (
  UPDATE automacao_miller.processing_attempts pa
  SET status = 'erro', current_stage = logged.current_stage,
      error_category = logged.error_category, error_message = logged.error_message,
      finished_at = NOW()
  FROM logged_error logged
  WHERE pa.attempt_id = logged.attempt_id
  RETURNING pa.submission_id
), closed_document AS (
  UPDATE automacao_miller.documents d
  SET status = 'erro', current_stage = logged.current_stage,
      message = logged.error_message, updated_at = NOW()
  FROM logged_error logged
  WHERE d.submission_id = logged.submission_id
  RETURNING d.submission_id
), failed_delivery AS (
  UPDATE automacao_miller.email_deliveries ed
  SET status = 'falhou', error_message = ctx.error_message
  FROM error_context ctx
  WHERE ed.delivery_id = ctx.delivery_id AND ctx.delivery_id > 0
  RETURNING ed.delivery_id
)
SELECT logged.submission_id, logged.attempt_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM closed_attempt) AS attempts_closed,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM closed_document) AS documents_closed,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM failed_delivery) AS deliveries_failed
FROM logged_error logged
